name: sp-deck
title_zh: 学生作业PPT，从零到可编辑成品只走一条路
tagline_zh: 只认学生自有的学术场景，你开口要改就动手。不碰商业模板，不套花哨设计，产出的每页都能自己再编辑。
tagline_en: For student-owned academic decks only. Edits or rebuilds on request—no corporate fluff, every slide stays editable.
desc_en: Use only for a clearly student-owned academic context when the user explicitly asks to create, edit, improve, or rebuild an editable PPT, PPTX, PowerPoint, or slide deck.
why_zh: 它不生成图片式PPT，而是直接产出结构完整的PPTX，每页文字、图形都是真对象，后续改字换图不返工。
why_en: It generates fully editable PPTX with real text and shapes, not image slides—so you can tweak later without rebuilding from.
limit_zh: 只认学生自有的学术场景，且必须明确要求创建或修改可编辑PPT。不处理商业演示、非PPT格式、或未明确要求可编辑的请求。
limit_en: Only for student-owned academic contexts with explicit request for editable PPT/PPTX. No business decks, non-PPT formats, or vague asks.
title_en: Student deck builder: from blank to editable PPTX
